requirement: Apply an update-pathogen command to an existing model: copy the name, description, and atypical flag, refresh UpdatedAt, keep the identity untouched, and always report success.

preconditions.text: The target model is tracked but not yet saved

inputs.text: Command with a new name, description, and atypical flag

returns.text: Success at ApplicationStatus.Success with no error
Name, description, and atypical flag are overwritten
UpdatedAt is refreshed and the identity stays unchanged

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the mapper always returns a successful result
